name: Bytecasting LMS - FAQ API
description:
Comprehensive FAQ Management API for Bytecasting LMS.

## Authentication
All endpoints require Bearer Token authentication using Laravel Sanctum.
Include the token in the Authorization header: `Bearer {your-token}`

## Features
- FAQ CRUD operations
- FAQ Category management
- Advanced filtering and search
- Pagination support
- Bulk operations
- Version management
